newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Lion Brewery soars on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Lion Brewery soars on fresh buying.

text.p: Shares of Lion Brewery Ltd jumped 11.43 percent or four rupees on Monday to 39 rupees in active buying, brokers said.
"Buying has returned to the share after the recent market correction brought it down to 35 rupees," said a broker who decliend to be identified.
Lion Brewery, a subsidiary of Ceylon Brewery Ltd, rose to 44 rupees from aound 22 rupees in the recent rally which ended on April 23.
Colombo stocks rallied due to good growth expectations, falling interest rates and an agreement between the government and opposition to work together to settle Sri Lanka's ethnic crisis.
